Course Overview

This course provided by the ALREI Institute delivers in-depth theoretical knowledge and practical skills.
Course Objectives
  • Understand key issues and the legal framework of labor and trade union rights.
  • Acquire practical tools for analysis, negotiation, and representation.
  • Develop action strategies tailored to the realities of workers in Africa.
Who Should Take This Course?
  • Trade unionists and worker organization leaders
  • Trade union educators and trainers
  • Actors in the formal and informal economy
  • Labor law researchers and professionals
Methodology & Pedagogical Approach

ALREI Institute courses combine theoretical insights, African case studies, downloadable resources, assessment quizzes, and interactive exchanges.
